title: L1 Visa 401(k) Withdrawal Tax: Complete Guide for Returning Home (2026)
description: Complete guide to 401(k) withdrawal tax for L1 visa holders returning to their home country. Learn US withholding rates, treaty benefits, early withdrawal penalties, rollover options, and strategies to minimize $20,000-$80,000 in taxes.
content:
## Quick Answer: L1 Visa 401(k) Withdrawal Tax

**When L1 workers return home and withdraw 401(k):**

**US withholding tax:**
- 30% automatic (non-treaty countries)
- 0-15% (treaty countries like UK, Canada, India)
- Plus 10% early withdrawal penalty if under age 59½

**Example:** $200K 401(k), age 40, returning to UK
- US withholding: 15% (UK treaty rate) = $30,000
- Early withdrawal penalty: 10% = $20,000
- **Total US tax: $50,000 (25%)**

**Better strategy:** Leave 401(k) in US until age 59½, withdraw penalty-free.
